'''Tos''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who served as a specialist in the [[Mantellian Army|Mantellian army]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the war he was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], where a [[Separatist War|civil war]] had broken out between the Republic backed [[Ord Mantell Central Authority]] and the [[Mantellian Separatist Movement]]. Triank was posted on the outskirts of the Republic held [[Fort Garnik]] on [[Avilatan]] island, where he operated a stall from which he sold heavy [[Armor/Legends|armor]]. While at his stall Tos wore the standard issue Mantellian army uniform: [[Color/Legends|blue]] armor and white [[Clothing/Legends|pants]]. He had blue skin, no hair and purple [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tos first appeared in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' released by [[BioWare]]. In the game Hurwell's acts as a Republic heavy armor vendor on Ord Mantell.
